rows.claim: Stage 3 produced teacher-validated scan-order improvements across tested native N values N12, N16, N24, and N40.
rows.supporting_datasets: combined552, best strategy table, record timeline
rows.caveats: Only tested N values and current 2D Abaqus teacher model.
rows.recommended_wording: Teacher-validated improvements are observed across tested native N values.
rows.unsafe_wording_to_avoid: Stage 3 solved all N or all scan strategies.

rows.claim: N24 and N40 evidence is mature and should be evidence-frozen.
rows.supporting_datasets: combined552 counts and N24/N40 record timeline
rows.caveats: Maturity is empirical within tested native teacher-labelled strategy space.
rows.recommended_wording: N24/N40 are mature enough for evidence freeze.

rows.claim: N12 and N16 were initially weaker / under-sampled but were substantially strengthened by recovery loops.
rows.supporting_datasets: combined480, combined520, combined552 counts and Run76 comparison
rows.caveats: N12/N16 still have fewer rows than N24/N40 but are sufficient for bounded reporting.
rows.recommended_wording: N12/N16 evidence was substantially strengthened by recovery and final diagnostic loops.
rows.unsafe_wording_to_avoid: N12/N16 are fully mature for arbitrary generalization.

rows.claim: The final native dataset supports bounded variable-N scan-order optimization over tested N values.
rows.caveats: Bounded to N12/N16/N24/N40, tested strategy space, current teacher model.
rows.recommended_wording: combined552 supports bounded variable-N optimization over tested native N values.

rows.claim: The candidate-generation loop beat initial hand-designed / heuristic baselines within the tested teacher-labelled strategy space.
rows.supporting_datasets: record timeline and prior comparison tables
rows.caveats: Baseline definition is limited to recorded heuristic/early teacher-labelled strategy pool.
rows.recommended_wording: The active-learning/offline policy loop outperformed initial heuristic baselines within the tested pool.
rows.unsafe_wording_to_avoid: It beat all possible scan strategies.

rows.claim: GNN and graph-pointer diagnostics were explored but remain auxiliary and are not the primary evidence for final claims.
rows.caveats: Diagnostics were not dominant enough to support superiority claims.

rows.claim: N32 legacy data is useful as auxiliary context but is not native Stage 3 teacher validation and must be reported with metric-semantic caveats.
rows.caveats: PEEQ/Mises semantics are proxy-mapped for N32.
rows.recommended_wording: N32 is auxiliary legacy-compatible context, separated from native claims.
rows.unsafe_wording_to_avoid: N32 was newly validated or caused native improvements.

rows.claim: The work supports offline policy optimization / active-learning / surrogate-guided scan-order generation, not online RL or arbitrary-N generalization.
rows.caveats: No online Abaqus control loop was executed.
rows.recommended_wording: The work supports offline active-learning/surrogate-guided policy optimization within bounds.
